name: orderbook
description: Offline LAN order & inventory management for a ceramic company

scripts.build: npm run build --workspace @orderbook/shared && npm run build --workspace @orderbook/master && npm run build --workspace @orderbook/office
scripts.predev:master: npm run build:shared && npm run build --workspace @orderbook/master-web
scripts.predev:office: npm run build:shared && npm run build --workspace @orderbook/office-web
scripts.prestart:master: npm run build:shared && npm run build --workspace @orderbook/master
scripts.prestart:office: npm run build:shared && npm run build --workspace @orderbook/office
scripts.seed:dummy: npm run build:shared && npm run seed:dummy --workspace @orderbook/master
scripts.seed:sample: npm run build:shared && npm run seed:sample --workspace @orderbook/master
scripts.seed:catalogue: npm run build:shared && npm run seed:catalogue --workspace @orderbook/master
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present && tsc -p tsconfig.test.json && tsc -p ui/tests/tsconfig.json && tsc -p electron/tsconfig.json --noEmit
scripts.verify: npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run test
